text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to get lunch, I 
spotted King Halo and the others.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! King's lunch is always nothing 
short of perfection!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Listen here, Sky! Hand over that 'Kyoto 
Vegetable Salad' you just took... That was 
the very last one, and it belongs to the 
King!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No way! Just put up with a different 
salad, please!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Kiiiiieeeeeeeh!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah! What's so funny?! Special Week-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, no. I was just thinking you're 
the same as always.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
King-chan is here, and Sei-chan is here 
too. Eating a meal together with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My debut the other day feels so surreal, 
almost like a dream. Even so...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. But next year, all of us will be 
taking on the Classics together."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And that means the one sitting upon the 
throne is King. Hey, Sky-san. Pass the soy 
sauce, would you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Please get it yourself~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Geez~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...My, my~. Everyone is so full of 
energy~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Grass-chan and El-chan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. I heard lively voices, so I 
couldn't resist popping in.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I understand what you meant earlier, 
though. It really makes you feel like it's 
finally begun, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Our... battle.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Once the gong sounds, the stage 
will forge a winner and a loser!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And now, for some extra special news! Take 
a look! Check out this article!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um... "'Next Year's Golden Generation': A 
Special Feature on the Upcoming Classic 
Races"?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa!? Everyone's names are in here! 
Amazing! There are photos too...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!? K-King-chan even has a special 
feature article...!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's the grand treatment befitting 
someone like me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The whole world is expecting it too. 
Expecting me to become the leading star of 
this generation.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Heeh.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was just wondering what the world 
would do if that all got overturned in an 
instant.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I really thought you would say, "What 
if *I* overturned it?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ooh~ King is so, so scary!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The Classics... The Triple Crown route... 
And the Japanese Derby too...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! King-chan!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What is it, Special Week-san?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
King-chan... are you running in the 
Derby?! On that grand stage where you can 
become the best in Japan?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I'm running. After all, it's one 
of the GIs I must claim.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I, see.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Just in time.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, about today's training... Could you 
make it just a little bit harder?"
choice_data_list: What's up all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Out of the blue or not, it doesn't matter. 
I just want to be stronger than anyone 
else in this generation.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No matter who is in the race, the one who 
wins must be none other than I, King Halo.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I need results that prove I am worthy of 
recognition.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If you understand, then let's 
prepare—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: W-Wah wah wah... K-K-King-san!

(—If I recall, she's Kawakami Princess. 
Word among trainers was that she's quite 
the tomboyish Umamusume, but...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't Kawakami-san. What's the 
matter? You look like you're choking on a 
cherry tomato.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um-um! The one featured in this is King 
Halo-san, isn't it!?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... that's true, but.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wah! So with those very words, you 
declared, "I won't give up. No matter what 
happens!"!? Just like PreFie!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pri... Figh...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, excuse me! PriFigh is short for 
'Princess☆Fighter,' and the protagonist is 
a strong princess, but..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh? No? Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, that's not it! What I really want 
to tell you is...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll be cheering you on in the Classic 
triple crown campaign, King-san!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... That level of hype is quite a 
first for me as well...
choice_data_list:
Still, they were totally captivated by 
you.

Still, they were totally captivated by 
you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...There's no doubt about that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but she alone is not enough. I am an 
Umamusume meant to be acknowledged by the 
entire world.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The real test begins now. Trainer, let's 
brace ourselves and stay focused.
